description: Validate JSON data against a JSON Schema (draft-07/2019-09/2020-12, formats like email/uri/date-time) and get every error with its exact path — check tool I/O before acting on it. Ajv, strict about types, all errors reported. Pass data and schema as JSON values (or JSON strings). Price: free. Errors: returns isError with a message for invalid input or an upstream failure (not charged).

data.description: any JSON value (or a JSON string with parse_strings=true)

parse_strings.description: true = if data is a string, parse it as JSON first. Default false.

schema.description: The JSON Schema to validate against.

name: json_schema_validate
title: JSON Schema validator
